verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is a payment-credentialing, tokenization, and trusted-agent-authentication platform for agent-initiated transactions; nothing in the evidence pack addresses publishing a product/service catalog or feed for AI agent discovery. Catalog/feed publishing is a distinct commerce-discovery function outside this product's scope (payment authorization, mandates, passkeys, agent signature verification), making this a category mismatch rather than a gap in an applicable capability.
